jobs.title: Data Analyst & QA Specialist
jobs.description: A unique hybrid role at the intersection of data, product, and quality assurance. Help ensure ClarityQ delivers accurate, reliable, and insightful answers to our customers while getting hands-on exposure to cutting-edge AI technology from day one. Responsibilities: Run analyses on customer and internal data to support POCs, customer success, and product decisions.; Assist in onboarding new customers and running POCs — validating data connections, verifying table, event and semantic catalogs, and making sure every evaluation runs smoothly.; Test new features and releases across the platform (Dashboards, Context Builder, Slack integration, and more), reproduce and document issues, and verify fixes before they reach customers.; Own the analytics of ClarityQ itself, using ClarityQ as your daily analytics tool — analyze how customers use our product, uncover insights on usage, engagement, and adoption, and surface findings that shape our product roadmap.; Leverage advanced AI tools to speed up testing, analysis, and documentation, and continuously find smarter ways to work.; Work hand-in-hand with our dynamic and fast-paced team, staying aligned on product developments, priorities, and goals. Requirements: Tons of motivation: hungry to learn, take ownership, and grow fast.; Agile: able to switch between analytics and testing quickly, juggle both when needed, and deliver under tight timelines without dropping quality.; Attention to detail: you notice the small things others miss and don't consider a task done until it's verified.; Analytical mindset: you enjoy digging into data, asking 'does this make sense?', and getting to the root of a problem.; Self-starter: you thrive in a fast-paced, unstructured environment and are excited by the challenge of building from scratch.; Curiosity: genuine interest in AI, data, our product, and the industry we are disrupting.; People person: great with people and comfortable working directly with customers — listening, communicating clearly in English, and building trust in every interaction.; Team player: work closely with a small fast-moving team, contributing to a shared vision and collective success.; Basic SQL knowledge and comfort working with data (academic, bootcamp, or hands-on experience all count).; Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.; Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.; Comfortable using AI tools as part of your daily workflow, or eager to learn fast.; Experience with QA, data analysis, BI tools, or data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks) is an advantage.; Experience working in an early-stage startup environment is an advantage.
